alert_lead: First Las Vegas-first run under $21k: 1 STRONG private local (2019 Leaf SV $9,995 / 46k mi, downtown LV) + 9 STRONG local dealer deals (2025 Tucson SEL $18,596 incl fees, 2024 Ariya $19,799, 2022 Model 3 LR AWD $19,498, 2019 Highlander XLE AWD $16,994, 2023 Bolt $18,038, 2024 ID.4 $18,987, 2021 CX-5 Touring AWD $18,794, 2022 Corolla Cross $19,990, 2025 Leaf S $15,299–15,699). No EXCEPTIONAL.

criteria.geo: LV metro first; tier 2 only if exceptional

new_strong_deals.title_status: clean (CL attr; seller: clean title in hand)
new_strong_deals.why_interesting: Private local Leaf SV at $9,995 vs ~$12.1k CarGurus 2019 LEAF avg / $12.5k VinAssessment median; seller: clean title in hand, newer tires; cash or local cashier's check.
new_strong_deals.concerns: Air-cooled pack in Vegas heat: verify battery health (dash capacity bars / LeafSpy SOH) before paying; ~110 mi real range per seller; duplicate CL post also live (2ZVECbrjSb4TDXmE1c81Hj).

new_strong_deals.why_interesting: Dual-motor Long Range 2022 Model 3 under $19.5k; 2022 Model 3 national median $25,525 (all trims).
new_strong_deals.concerns: Buy-here-pay-here style ad ("bad credit OK") — get cash OTD in writing (doc/fees likely extra) and Carfax/AutoCheck for accident history; posted 2026-09-08 (a month on market).

new_strong_deals.why_interesting: 3-row 2019 Highlander XLE AWD under $17k; 2019 Highlander national median $24,487.
new_strong_deals.concerns: Price this far under market at a subprime-financing lot: insist on Carfax (accident/rental/fleet), cash OTD in writing, and an independent pre-purchase inspection.
